chapters.label: The goal, live
chapters.text: Anfield, 2022. Liverpool are losing to Crystal Palace, with ten players. Luis Díaz gets the ball on the left, and runs straight at the defenders... past one... past two... still going... right foot... goal!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Díaz runs straight at each defender, so they back off. Then he changes speed and bursts past.

chapters.label: Past five
chapters.text: He weaves past five Palace players along the edge of the box, and fires it past keeper Vicente Guaita!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: run straight at defenders to make them back off, then burst past them!
